Locate your next [[assassin]] trainer, [[Panaku]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Assassin
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Seek out Panaku in Kinya Province.

===Reward===
* 600 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
After completing the [[Opening Strike]] quest, speak with [[Jinzo]] at point A on the map. After accepting this quest, take the path to the north-west, then west through the courtyard of [[Minister Cho's Estate]]. Just past the courtyard you will encounter a group of 2-3 [[Crimson Skull]].  You'll find two more groups further down the path, along with a boss, [[Yingko the Skull Claw]]. You will likely not be high enough level to take him on, so simply continue through [[Tomaat Pass]] to [[Kinya Province]]; following the path on the map until you reach [[Panaku]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Jinzo
''[[Panaku]] is ready to continue your training. He has much to teach you, but you must take his words with a grain of salt. Headmaster Lee often says we are two sides of the same blade. Panaku has a certain...passion...for his work that is foreign to me, and I worry about his effect on young minds. However, it is important that your training be balanced, so off you go. Seek him out in [[Kinya Province]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will seek out Panaku.
| decline = I must prepare, first.
| ask = I understand your reticence, but you must continue your training. You will find Panaku in [[Kinya Province]].
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Panaku
:''So, Jinzo has taught you the basics, has he? Well, if you are ready to get serious, you have come to the right place. Now the real fun begins....''
